test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: All 45 people are standing in a row facing north. Tina is 20th from the right end while Belamit is 28th from the left end. How many people are there between Tina and Belamit?
solution:
• Total people = 4
 
• All facing north (this means “left” and “right” are just positions, not directions of facing)
 
• Tina is 20th from the right end
 
• Belamit is 28th from the left end
 
• Find Tina’s position from the left end
 
• 
 If Tina is 20th from the right, her position from the left is:

 Position from left=45−20+1=26

 So, Tina is 26th from the left end.
 
 
• 
 

 
Number of people **between** them:=(28−26)−1

 

​ =2−1=1.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
